scope: Grid search/filter/sort/paging behaviour, read from live ExtJS component configuration rather than by clicking menus.
method: Ext.ComponentQuery.query('grid') -> column definitions (`filter` config), store proxy (storeUrl, remoteSort/remoteFilter, pageSize) and paging toolbar. No filter menu was opened - see `notEnumerated`.

byExample.string: Name, Job Type, Status, Input File, Log File, ProjectEntityName

filterTypesObserved.reading: Observed. Filtering is declared PER COLUMN in the grid definition via a `filter: {type: ...}` config. Columns without that config (e.g. the Actions/EditDeleteLink column and the row-expander) are not filterable at all.

notEnumerated: The OPERATORS offered inside each filter menu (contains / before-after-on / greater-less) were NOT enumerated - that needs the menu to be opened, which is a UI interaction I did not perform under the read-only remit. What is established is the filter TYPE per column, which determines which operator set appears.

sortingAndPaging.reading: Observed. `remoteSort: true` means sorting is SERVER-SIDE - the store re-requests from storeUrl rather than sorting the loaded page. So sorting and paging act on the whole result set, not just the visible 15 rows. A page-size selector is present, so the user can change page size at runtime.

storeUrl: /servlet/BOList - all admin grids share one list servlet, parameterised by BOType plus a per-page-load `fdName` token. Filter/sort state travels as query parameters to that servlet, which confirms filter state is SERVER-SIDE, not client-side.
columnsAreLayoutDriven: NOT established at AF. I could not reach a genuine end-user `PLForm.jsp` list: `ContractEdit.jsp` and `LocationEdit.jsp` both redirect to `EntityActivate.jsp` (an activate/reset grid), and nav tree nodes carry no static href to build a PLForm URL from. So whether a user can add columns at runtime, and whether visible columns equal the LIST layout's fields, remains UNANSWERED - it needs a populated end-user list, which BBW is better placed to supply.
savedFilters: A toolbar button labelled **`Entity Filters..`** exists alongside `Search` / `Close Search`, which suggests named/saved filters - but I did not open it, so treat the existence as Observed and the behaviour as unknown.
cautionForScreenshots: These admin screens are ExtJS VIEWPORT apps - the document is ~1000px tall and grids scroll INTERNALLY. A full-page screenshot shows one screenful of any grid regardless of capture height. Never infer row counts from an image; use the totals in this file.
